title: G1 — Transforms, hierarchy, masks and constraints
exercises: non-identity transforms, negative determinants, parentIndex trees, frameMaskDisabled, MaskType, ConstraintType, SECTION
record: the rotation angles and flip directions
selection: the frame `G1 geometry` and the section `G1f section` beside it (a section cannot sit inside a frame)
notes: G1a rotated: frame rotation 15°; children G1a child 30 (30°) and G1a child -45 (−45°), relative to the frame.
G1b flip horizontal: group mirrored left-right (relativeTransform a = −1); G1b flip vertical: mirrored top-bottom (d = −1).
G1c: frame > G1c outer group > G1c inner group > G1c leaf. G1d: clip content on, G1d overflow extends 80 px past the right edge.
G1e: G1e mask shape (ellipse, isMask, ALPHA) masks G1e masked image inside group G1e mask.
G1g constraints (horizontal, vertical): left top MIN/MIN, right top MAX/MIN, center CENTER/CENTER, left and right STRETCH/MAX, scale SCALE/SCALE.
G1f section is a top-level section beside G1 geometry: a section cannot be a frame child. The SVG export covers G1 geometry only.
provenance: Authored for the Penumbra Figma interchange tests by scripts/figma-fixtures in a scratch Figma file; synthetic content only. Built by Penumbra scripts/figma-curate.
